title: Antique Copper Glass Shelf, 16-Inch Wall-Mounted Triple Tier With Towel Bar, Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
description: Glass shelf for bathroom storage and display, sized 16 inches x 5 inches (16-inch, 16in) with an integrated towel bar and triple-tier design — available in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms. Use as a bathroom glass shelf, wall shelf, or wall-mounted shelf for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories. Built with 3/8-in thick (0.38 in) tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware. Wall mount installation with concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look; includes the glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4". Overall dimensions: 16 in length, 5 in width/depth, 18 in height; weight capacity 6 lb; product weight 12.8 lb. Assembly required: no. Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass.
